items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: this fellow, George Spafford, was an electrician... he sent me around Frank Torres.

ctx.x: But you were going to tell us about Kid Ross.

Well, that's why I'm going to bring in Kid Ross. Yeah, okay. After I walked back in the district, and this fellow, George Spafford, was an electrician, took, you know, the cribs and all that, he sent me around Frank Torres. And Kid Ross was playing there, see? I mean, Kid Ross was in the room, uh, hearts was a great game in there. You know hearts?
